Note. Each source outcome's 20 highest-ranked predictors by bootstrap mean |SHAP| in its cross-sectional model (for frailty, the model excluding the 29 content-overlapping predictors; Table S2) were refit as 5-fold cross-validated models of the target outcome, with outcomes residualized on age within fold. Target R², the target's own full-model R² (177 predictors). Source top 20, all 20 source predictors with hyperparameters tuned as in the primary models; their R² recovered 25% to 73% of the target's. Decomposition: shared, the source predictors also among the target's top 20; source-unique, the remaining source predictors; target-unique, the target's top 20 not among the source's, predicting the target itself; these sets were fit with fixed hyperparameters (tree depth 3, learning rate .01, 500 trees). Random-partition null: the shared set and 1,000 random subsets of the source's top 20 of the same size, each fit with the fixed hyperparameters on one 80/20 split of the target sample; P is the proportion of random subsets whose R² reached the shared set's. Each outcome's ranking is in Table S17.
